Sen Kaibara (Provisional License).name: Sen Kaibara (Provisional License)
Sen Kaibara (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Sen Kaibara, hero name Spiral, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and a provisional license holder; all of 1-B passed the exam, at a different venue from 1-A. Shaggy dark-brown hair, narrow dark eyes, a lean build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Plain and dry: short corrections and flat one-liners, said once.
Combat Role: Close-range capture: drilling strikes and spinning deflections, timed with teammates.
Under Pressure: Takes the nearest rescue or capture job and keeps grandstanders on task.
Sen Kaibara (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The summer showed him real villains; his answer is a simple Quirk made dependable. Motivation: Be the licensed hero who does the plain job right. Concealment: Unease about the summer hides behind the deadpan. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, who drilled 1-B as a unit for the exam. Thread: Whether a plain fighter becomes the one his class relies on.
QUIRK: Gyrate, practiced: longer, steadier spins of his own body; contact range only, and a spinning limb can be caught, cut or hurt.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: licensed, Spiral.
personality: Straight man: Deflates dorm bravado with one dry line.
Steady: Drills his basics instead of talking about the summer.
Impatient: Names classmates' excess once, then gets back to work.
Speaking style: Plain, grounded remarks and short corrections; dry, never a speech.
abilities: Drilling strike: A practiced spinning blow that breaks guards, restraints and light obstacles; controlled against people.
Spin deflection: Turns aside a manageable blow; heavy, piercing or ranged attacks get through.
Capture teamwork: Breaks a target's guard or grip so a teammate can make the arrest.
Provisional license: May act as a hero in an emergency without waiting for a pro; he is still a student under U.A.'s rules.
Fighting style: Spins the opening attack aside and drills into the guard, timed with teammates for the capture.
Sen Kaibara (Provisional License).visualDescription: A young man with shaggy dark-brown hair, narrow dark eyes, slightly tanned skin and a lean build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Level, unimpressed expression with a faint, dry half-smile.
